focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会进一步细化了钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢等六大行业的碳排放核算与申报规则，并强化了对间接排放的核查要求。中国出口企业若未能建立符合欧盟标准的碳足迹监测与报告体系，将面临额外的碳成本甚至贸易壁垒。建议企业尽快梳理对欧出口产品清单，完善上游供应链碳数据收集，并评估在欧盟境内设立合规实体的必要性。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.30
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Period Nears End, Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The transitional period of the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will conclude by the end of 2026, with the definitive regime taking effect from 2027. The European Commission has recently refined carbon emission calculation and reporting rules for six sectors—iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen—while tightening verification requirements for indirect emissions. Chinese exporters that fail to establish EU-compliant carbon footprint monitoring and reporting systems may face additional carbon costs or even trade barriers. Companies are advised to promptly map out EU-bound product lists, enhance upstream supply chain carbon data collection, and assess the need to establish compliance entities within the EU.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认与执行中国法院商事判决，明确互惠关系认定标准
case.summary: 新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）近期在一宗跨境货物买卖合同纠纷中，依据《新加坡国际商事法庭法》及普通法互惠原则，承认并执行了中国某中级人民法院作出的生效商事判决。法院重点审查了原判决程序的正当性、管辖权基础及是否存在欺诈情形，最终认定中国法院的判决符合新加坡法律对终局性和确定性的要求。该案为中新两国间民商事判决的跨境流通提供了重要先例，也提示中国企业在跨境交易中应注重合同管辖条款的设计与证据留存，以便未来在普通法法域申请执行。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026年第三季度
case.title_en: SICC Recognises and Enforces Chinese Commercial Judgment, Clarifying Reciprocity Test
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a final commercial judgment rendered by an intermediate people's court of China in a cross-border sale of goods dispute, relying on the SICC Act and common law principles of reciprocity. The court scrutinised the propriety of the original proceedings, the basis of jurisdiction, and the absence of fraud, ultimately finding that the Chinese judgment satisfied Singapore law's requirements for finality and conclusiveness. This case sets an important precedent for the cross-border circulation of civil and commercial judgments between China and Singapore, and underscores the need for Chinese enterprises to carefully design jurisdiction clauses and preserve evidence in cross-border transactions to facilitate future enforcement in common law jurisdictions.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Commercial Court · Q3 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，整合调解仲裁诉讼资源
policy.summary: 广东省司法厅与香港律政司、澳门法务局近期联合推出粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷“一站式”在线解纷平台，整合三地调解、仲裁及诉讼资源，为跨境企业提供在线立案、远程调解、电子送达及仲裁裁决跨境执行协助等服务。平台首批接入广州仲裁委员会、深圳国际仲裁院、香港国际仲裁中心及澳门世界贸易中心仲裁中心等机构，并发布统一调解规则指引。此举旨在降低三地企业跨境解纷的时间与费用成本，提升大湾区法治化营商环境。企业应关注平台规则，在合同中约定适用该机制以增强争议解决效率。
policy.source: 来源：广东省司法厅、香港律政司、澳门法务局 · 2026年9月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Launches One-Stop Online Dispute Resolution Platform for Cross-Border Commercial Disputes
policy.summary_en: The Guangdong Department of Justice, the Hong Kong Department of Justice, and Macao's Legal Affairs Bureau have jointly launched a one-stop online dispute resolution platform for cross-border commercial disputes in the Greater Bay Area, integrating mediation, arbitration, and litigation resources across the three jurisdictions. The platform offers online case filing, remote mediation, electronic service, and assistance with cross-border enforcement of arbitral awards. Founding institutions include the Guangzhou Arbitration Commission, the Shenzhen Court of International Arbitration, the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre, and the Macao World Trade Center Arbitration Center, alongside unified mediation rules. The initiative aims to reduce time and cost for businesses in the three regions and enhance the rule-of-law business environment. Companies should familiarise themselves with the platform's rules and consider incorporating them into contracts to improve dispute resolution efficiency.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Department of Justice, Hong Kong Department of Justice, Macao Legal Affairs Bureau · September 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体出口管制新规下，企业需构建“穿透式”合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部近期进一步收紧对华半导体制造设备及高端芯片的出口管制，新增多项“外国直接产品规则”限制，并将多家中国实体列入实体清单。新规不仅约束美国原产技术，还扩展至使用美国软件或设备在第三国生产的产品。中国企业在采购、研发及国际合作中面临更高的合规风险。建议企业立即开展供应链穿透式排查，识别受控物项与技术来源；完善内部出口管制合规制度，对交易对方进行强化尽职调查；并在合同中加入出口管制变更条款与免责条款，以应对政策突变带来的履约风险。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.09.30
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Building a 'Look-Through' Compliance System Amid New US Semiconductor Export Controls
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Department of Commerce has recently further tightened export controls on semiconductor manufacturing equipment and advanced chips destined for China, adding multiple Foreign Direct Product Rule restrictions and placing several Chinese entities on the Entity List. The new rules not only capture US-origin technology but also extend to products manufactured in third countries using US software or equipment. Chinese enterprises face heightened compliance risks in procurement, R&D, and international cooperation. Companies should immediately conduct look-through supply chain audits to identify controlled items and technology sources; enhance internal export control compliance programmes and conduct enhanced due diligence on counterparties; and incorporate export control change-of-law and force majeure clauses into contracts to mitigate performance risks arising from abrupt policy shifts.
